hook.text: Facebook receives 4 million reports daily. A human reviewer gets 10 seconds per case. Context is a luxury they lack.

buildup.text: Moderators see beheadings, child abuse, and self-harm for 8 hours daily. PTSD rates among them are staggering.

discovery.text: AI moderation catches 90% of spam but struggles with context. Satire, sarcasm, and cultural nuance break it.

twist.text: Most moderators are contractors in the Philippines earning $2 an hour. The human cost is outsourced and hidden.

climax.text: At scale, perfect moderation is impossible. Platforms must choose between over-censoring and under-moderating.

punchline.text: Moderation at scale is a problem no one has solved.

quiz.question: Why is content moderation at scale so difficult?
options: AI can't handle context, and humans can't handle volume
